parts.text: {"title": "Guide", "sections": [{"heading": "Incident runbook", "text": "Alerts page the on-call engineer through the paging service. The on-call rota changes every Sunday at 09:00. After fifteen minutes without acknowledgement the lead is paged. After thirty minutes a bridge call is opened and the status page is updated.", "sources": ["doc-runbook"]}, {"heading": "Onboarding guide", "text": "New members receive a laptop on the first day. Accounts are created by the platform team within two business days. Every new member pairs with a buddy for the first week. The buddy books the introduction meetings with each hub", "sources": ["doc-onboarding"]}, {"heading": "Release process", "text": "Releases ship every two weeks on a Wednesday. A release freeze starts on the Monday before the release. Each release needs sign-off from the test lead and the release manager. Sign-off is recorded in the release hub before the freeze", "sources": ["doc-release"]}, {"heading": "Board export", "text": "The export writes every visible column of the board to a CSV file. Hidden columns are never exported. An export covers at most five thousand rows. Larger boards are exported in pages named by their page number.
